from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# 1. Search for emails about the hiking trip
hiking_emails = search_emails(query="hiking trip Mark", sender=None)

if not hiking_emails:
    hiking_emails = search_emails(query="hiking", sender=None)

if not hiking_emails:
    raise ValueError("No emails found regarding the hiking trip with Mark.")

# 2. Extract details from the most recent email
email = hiking_emails[0]

class EventDetails(BaseModel):
    date: str
    start_time: str
    location: str

details = query_ai_assistant(
    prompt=f"Extract the date, start time, and location for the hiking trip with Mark from the following email. \n\nEmail Subject: {email.subject}\nEmail Body: {email.body}\n\nReturn a JSON object with keys 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD), 'start_time' (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), and 'location' (string).",
    response_model=EventDetails
)

# 3. Calculate end time (5 hours duration)
start_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(details.start_time)
end_dt = start_dt + timedelta(hours=5)

# 4. Find Mark's email
mark_contact = search_contacts_by_name("Mark")

if not mark_contact:
    raise ValueError("Contact 'Mark' not found.")

mark_email = mark_contact[0].email

# 5. Create the event structure for the email attachment
event_attachment = {
    "type": "event",
    "event_details": {
        "title": "Hiking Trip with Mark",
        "description": email.body,
        "start_time": details.start_time,
        "end_time": end_dt.isoformat(),
        "location": details.location,
        "participants": [mark_email]
    }
}

# 6. Send the email to Mark to invite him to the event
send_email(
    recipients=[mark_email],
    subject="Hiking Trip Invitation",
    body=f"Hi Mark, based on our conversation, I've scheduled our hiking trip for {details.date} at {details.location}. Please find the event details attached.",
    attachments=[event_attachment],
    cc=None,
    bcc=None
)
